propositions: Current clarity measure conflates volume rewards with plan structure validation, allowing padded tickets without required sections to pass
Clarity score logic is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py, creating maintenance and drift risk

Seven mechanically testable criteria—required sections by graph altitude, AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, file-impact structure, AC hygiene, testing markers, and nonempty Context/Problem/Approach—can be added deterministically without semantic judgment
Per-check evidence reporting should replace raw length/bullet-point scoring to prevent filler compensation for missing required sections
Author guide conflicts with authoritative criteria on Success Criteria heading treatment and rejected-alternative requirements, blocking clarity rule encoding until resolved
